workarounds.symptom: OpenAI-compatible providers send response_format json_schema; gateways without it (DeepSeek) fail every analyzer with HTTP 400
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(analyzer): fall back to unforced tool calling when a gateway rejects json_schema. Target files: src/skillspector/inspection_ledger.py, src/skillspector/llm_analyzer_base.py, src/skillspector/llm_utils.py. OpenAI-compatible gateways without JSON-schema response_format (DeepSeek) answer every LLM analyzer request with HTTP 400, while the report still says llm_available: true with risk 0 / LOW. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector/pull/1092)

workarounds.symptom: Inline HTML or autolink backtick hides a Markdown declared-marker instruction (SAFE)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: withhold Markdown code-span ownership across inline HTML. Target files: src/skillspector/security_reconstruction.py, tests/nodes/analyzers/test_structured_marker_ownership.py. Impact: silent-wrong-result (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector/pull/1082)
